$Comment: Spawns the Thumper deployable at the spot the gate chose. Arrakis_Thumper_Place is our own interaction type: it takes the same Config as the vanilla SpawnDeployableAtLocation and calls the same DeployablesUtils.spawnDeployable, with the position from the gate instead of a fixed offset; the owner is the player, which Worms reads. A deployable of type Aoe with DamageAmount 0 and no effects does nothing but stand: no HitboxCollisionConfig, so it never blocks or pushes the player; Invulnerable; LiveDuration 0 is no despawn timer (the engine adds one only above 0). Model: Arrakis_Thumper (the vanilla torch model and texture, re-encoded). MaxLiveCount and LiveDuration are overwritten at server start from MaxLivePerPlayer and MaxLiveSeconds in the Thumper config.
